high.title: Rupiah and IHSG Weaken, Palace: Our Economic Fundamentals Are Strong
high.summary: Indonesia's financial markets face significant pressure with IHSG down 32.46% in 2026 and rupiah touching Rp 18,049 per USD. Government maintains economic fundamentals remain strong despite market volatility, citing controlled inflation and economic growth.

high.title: Purbaya Opens Up About USD Breaking Rp 18,000: I Leave It to BI
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya responds to rupiah weakening to Rp 18,044 per USD, stating exchange rate management is Bank Indonesia's authority. He shows confidence in BI's ability to handle the situation and sees no need for emergency KSSK meetings.

high.title: IHSG Parks at Level 5,839, Down 1.70%
high.summary: Indonesian stock index IHSG closed down 1.70% at 5,839.78, after touching lows around 5,600 level during trading. The index has corrected significantly from its 9,100+ peak earlier in 2026, with high trading volume of Rp 25.52 trillion.

high.title: Purbaya Reveals Main Culprit Behind Continuous IHSG Decline: Negative Perception of Economy
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya attributes IHSG's 35.30% decline to negative sentiment toward domestic economy, despite strong fundamentals. He emphasizes that Indonesia's budget and economic growth remain solid, with increased economic activity nationwide.

high.title: BI Governor Meets Dasco-Purbaya at DPR, Agrees on 2 Strategies to Protect Rupiah Exchange Rate
high.summary: Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo emphasizes strengthened fiscal-monetary coordination with Finance Ministry to stabilize rupiah. The meeting focuses on synchronized policies between fiscal and monetary authorities to support exchange rate stability.

high.title: Viral 'Sell Indonesia' After Rupiah-IHSG Slump, Purbaya Speaks Out
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya responds to international media's 'sell Indonesia' narrative amid rupiah and IHSG weakness. He argues the phenomenon doesn't fully reflect Indonesia's economic conditions and suggests some international writers lack understanding of Indonesia's situation.

high.title: Is Indonesia Really Heading Toward 1998-Style Crisis?
high.summary: Economists assess Indonesia's current economic conditions compared to the 1998 crisis, concluding the country is far from a similar crisis. Current rupiah weakness to Rp 18,000+ is significantly different from 1998's collapse from Rp 4,000 to over Rp 16,000.

high.title: Indonesian Government Bonds Remain Resilient Amid Global Turmoil, Here Are the Factors
high.summary: Deputy Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara claims Indonesian government bond market remains strong despite global volatility, supported by policy credibility and stable domestic investor base. The government maintains 3% fiscal deficit commitment for sustainable economic management.

medium.title: Purbaya Overhauls DJP Performance Allowance, Discipline Violations Impact Income
medium.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya revises performance allowance calculation for tax office employees through new regulation PMK No. 39/2026. The changes consider organizational performance, employee performance, job ranking, and disciplinary enforcement to improve overall performance.

medium.title: 4 Bold Moves by New BGN Chief for MBG Budget Efficiency
medium.summary: New National Nutrition Agency head Nanik Sudaryati implements budget efficiency measures, cutting allocation from Rp 335 trillion to Rp 268 trillion while maintaining Free Nutritious Meal program beneficiaries. The agency focuses on refocusing beneficiaries and operational efficiency.

medium.title: Deputy Minister of Immigration Silmy Karim Becomes KPK Suspect with Rp 234 Billion Assets
medium.summary: Deputy Minister of Immigration Silmy Karim surrenders to KPK following corruption charges, with reported assets worth Rp 234.59 billion. Most wealth consists of 11 properties in Jakarta valued at Rp 184 billion plus securities holdings.

medium.title: Unilever Distributes Rp 4.32 Trillion Dividend End of June
medium.summary: Unilever Indonesia announces final dividend of Rp 4.32 trillion for 2025, part of total dividend distribution of Rp 7.63 trillion. The company recorded net sales of Rp 31.9 trillion and net profit of Rp 3.5 trillion in 2025.

medium.title: Multiple Aspects Experience Growth, Alfamart Distributes Rp 1.7 Trillion Dividend
medium.summary: Alfamart announces dividend distribution of approximately Rp 1.7 trillion or Rp 41.5 per share following strong 2025 performance. The decision reflects the company's solid financial performance across multiple business aspects.

medium.title: Bank Mandiri Taspen Fires Employee Suspected of Investment Fraud
medium.summary: Bank Mandiri Taspen terminates employee involved in investment fraud scheme at Purwokerto branch, Central Java. The bank emphasizes zero tolerance for actions violating integrity and corporate governance principles.

medium.title: KoinWorks Boss Detained by Attorney General, Shareholders Summoned by OJK
medium.summary: OJK responds to corruption case involving PT Lunaria Annua Teknologi (KoinWorks) with three suspects detained, including current and former directors. OJK has summoned shareholders of the peer-to-peer lending company for questioning.

medium.title: Djarum Group Emiten IBST Plans Delisting with Voluntary Tender at Rp 5,400 per Share
medium.summary: Djarum Group's PT Inti Bangun Sejahtera announces delisting plan from IDX with voluntary tender offer at Rp 5,400 per share. The VTO price is higher than previous mandatory tender offer of Rp 4,067 per share in October 2024.

medium.title: Vietnam's Imports Rise Dramatically, Trade Balance Deficit Hits Record
medium.summary: Vietnam's trade deficit reaches record high of $5.21 billion in May 2026, up from $3.28 billion in April, driven by soaring imports amid rising global commodity prices. Despite 18% export growth, imports outpaced expectations significantly.

medium.title: SBY's Strategy to Help Indonesia Survive 2008 Economic Crisis
medium.summary: Former President SBY shares experience managing 2008 global financial crisis, emphasizing Indonesia survived through maintaining market confidence, fiscal prudence, domestic demand support, and good policy coordination. Market participants focus on policy direction and governance during uncertainty.
